channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
item.description: As AI becomes harder to avoid, consumers are growing more wary of the technology — and Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn’t necessarily lead to acceptance.

item.title: Coders are slacking when it comes to web standards — and that simply won't do in the AI age
item.description: French developer leads project to discover how closely website developers stick to web standards, and the results are disappointing.

item.title: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
item.description: As we're gearing up for back-to-school season, Google is rolling out a new dedicated student hub in Gemini. It's a one-stop repository for collecting research in a study notebook, creating flashcards, taking practice quizzes, and more. Google is also enhancing its study notebooks with support for graphs and images. It can even add test dates […]

item.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
item.description: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.

item.title: Google is offering college students a year of its AI Pro plan for free
item.description: College students can get a free year of Google's AI Pro plan, something that would normally cost $200.

item.title: These are the best airport lounges in America, according to travelers
item.description: J.D. Power just ranked the nation’s airport lounge networks, and two credit card heavyweights tied for the top spot. Airport lounges are often a must-stop for passengers beginning and ending their trips—but not all are created equal.

item.title: Intelligence artificielle | Des livres imprimés détruits pour nourrir l’IA
item.description: L’intelligence artificielle (IA) et les livres ne font pas bon ménage. Ou peut-être que l’IA et les livres imprimés, au contraire, font trop bon ménage. Dans tous les cas, les acteurs du secteur du livre, une technologie vieille de 500 ans, commencent à voir l’IA générative née il n’y a pas cinq ans comme une menace destructrice… littéralement.

item.title: AirPods with cameras could not arrive at a worse time — and I'll just say no
item.description: Apple may have accidentally leaked its AirPods with Cameras plans, and it's clear that this is the last thing our ears need.

item.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
item.description: The idea behind OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber program is to give trusted defenders better models so they can report bugs and vulnerabilities to companies, with the aim of getting flaws patched faster.

item.title: There’s never been a better time to be a marketer
item.description: Marketing work will change, roles will shift, and career paths will deviate but the mission will stay the same. From ads on papyrus scrolls to scrolling our social feeds, marketing has been around as long as there have been things to sell. Whether it was textiles in some bustling bazaar in the Valley of the Kings, or SaaS in a digital marketplace in Silicon Valley, the channels keep changing, but the mandate never does. ...

item.title: Study finds a 15 percent increase in traffic deaths after major music streaming releases
item.description: Drivers may be more distracted on days when a big new album drops.

item.title: Mattel is releasing a full-scale building brick set of the original Xbox
item.description: The $330 Xbox building set includes a controller that interacts with three game-inspired dioramas.

item.title: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
item.description: Valve just leaked several new videos showing the Steam Frame's unboxing, setup process, and various accessories. The videos apparently appeared on the ARM Steam client following an update, but they were "quickly pulled after that," according to the Steam Hardware Updates account on X. The Steam Frame is Valve's virtual-reality headset that can stream games […]...

item.title: 'There is no reliable, economical one-size-fits-all model on the horizon': Experts claim AI costs will grow fivefold by 2028, as demand continues to soar
item.description: Experts have determined some uncomfortable truths about token economics, where falling token prices are pushing the development of complex agentic workflows, outweighing the savings

item.title: Deus Ex and Dishonored designer Harvey Smith has a new studio making immersive sims
item.description: New gaming studio Black Pony Immersive has veterans from Arkane, Insomniac and Epic.

item.title: The wearable future is stuck in weird, experimental, existential limbo

item.title: Trump picks White House aide Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the FDA
item.description: Overton faces challenges left by her predecessor and the priorities of the Make America Healthy Again movement. Dr. Heidi Overton, a top White House aide, has been picked to lead the Food and Drug Administration, President Donald Trump announced Wednesday.

item.title: IKEA is teasing some Xbox... things
item.description: Who wouldn't want to rest their tush on a green Xbox logo cushion?

item.title: Une « nouvelle unité » d’urgence contre les cyberattaques : la France veut une équipe de choc pour contrer les pirates
item.description: La France réagit à la vague de cyberattaques contre les services de l'État. Le Premier ministre a décreté la création d'une « nouvelle unité » d'urgence chargée d'agir « en première ligne » en cas de violation de données.
